purpose: Bounded FHE operation and application contracts, with measured CKKS integration results separate from pending complete bootstrapping.

rules.timing: GPU-resident complete application call after setup; report setup, key generation, transfers, and steady state separately.
rules.correctness: CKKS compares native and adapted integer ciphertexts exactly, and reports decoded errors against CPU double plaintext operations without an implicit floating threshold; TFHE reports exact decrypted bits for every sample.
rules.comparison: Run pinned native HEonGPU and cuButterfly adapter on identical ciphertexts, keys, streams, and batch shapes.
rules.fairness: The primary metric is the complete public application call. Adapter, layout conversion, extra launches, allocation, and synchronization costs remain inside the cuButterfly timed path; setup, key generation, encryption, decryption, and host transfers are reported separately.
rules.unsupported: An isolated NTT timing cannot fill an application result. A missing fused or layout-compatible dispatch blocks only the cuButterfly replacement result, not the native reference measurement.

complete_operation_comparison.status: measured; adapted paths exact but slower than native
complete_operation_comparison.security_level: none; integration parameters, not production-security validation
complete_operation_comparison.batch_lowering: independent ciphertexts submitted through scalar public API on one stream; per-call RNS grouping, no cross-ciphertext fusion
complete_operation_comparison.graph_validation: all captured temporary allocations reserved; native eager equivalence for original, changed and restored encrypted inputs; output-lifetime validation
complete_operation_comparison.selection: public auto-select, actual selection logged; tested requests used unmeasured feasible fallback rather than calibrated registry entries
complete_operation_comparison.timing: complete Graph GPU event time; matched eager wall-clock diagnostics reported separately

tfhe.application: HEonGPU TFHE Boolean circuits and bootstrapping
tfhe.standalone_keyswitch: Pinned torus32 decomposition, table lookup and accumulation contain no NTT; retain as unchanged non-butterfly component, not a cuButterfly speedup claim.

modulus_api.note: TFHE torus modulus switching is internal to bootstrapping kernels; the pinned public API exposes no standalone mod-up or mod-down operation.

workloads.operator: NAND, AND, NOR, OR, XNOR, XOR, NOT

workloads.name: tfhe_boolean_circuit
workloads.timing_boundary: GPU-resident circuit from encrypted inputs to encrypted output; report per-gate and complete-circuit timing separately

workloads.name: tfhe_bootstrap_key_switch_path
workloads.operator: public gate call with explicit bootstrap and key-switch attribution
workloads.timing_boundary: complete public gate call plus profiler attribution for pre-computation, bootstrap, sample extraction, and key switching
workloads.correctness: exact decrypted bits; attribution is diagnostic and cannot replace complete-call timing

tfhe.implementation_boundary: TFHE uses SmallForwardNTT/SmallInverseNTT inside fused bootstrapping kernels; public cuButterfly NTT timing is not an equivalent replacement. A complete public-gate comparison remains valid with the extra adapter work included in its elapsed time.
tfhe.minimum_adapter: Expose a device-level fused small-NTT callback or a templated bootstrapping-kernel variant while preserving shared-memory layout, root tables, modular arithmetic, and caller stream. The replacement must cover the complete gate call, including pre-computation, bootstrap, sample extraction, and key switching.
blockers: implement the cuButterfly device-level callback or templated bootstrap variant
prove replacement-kernel numerical equivalence before timing
record native and replacement NTT calls inside the complete bootstrap
excluded_claims: standalone TFHE mod-up or mod-down speedup, because no such public API exists in the pinned source
isolated public NTT timing as a TFHE application result
bootstrap-only timing presented as a complete TFHE application
